## Connection

Connect tokens, client slots, the handshake, keep-alive, disconnects and timeouts between a client and a server.

<!-- nova-work:connection:start -->

| feature | done |
|---|:---:|
| connect tokens issued by a web backend | ✅ |
| request, challenge and response handshake | ✅ |
| client slots; a full server denies at once | ✅ |
| many clients on one server | ✅ |
| fall through to the next server in the token | ✅ |
| keep-alive | ✅ |
| clean disconnect from the client | ✅ |
| clean disconnect from the server, with a reason | ✅ |
| request, response and connection timeouts | ✅ |
| expired and invalid connect tokens refused | ✅ |
| reconnect with a new token | ✅ |
| timeouts can be disabled for debugging | ✅ |
| loopback clients inside the server process | ✅ |
| loopback refuses to connect without its send callback | ❌ |
| the disconnect callback cannot re-enter a slot being cleared | ❌ |
| the client skips a server address it has no socket for | ❌ |
| complete | 81% |

[Source data](docs/roadmap.sexp)

<!-- nova-work:connection:end -->

## Security

Encrypted, signed packets and the protections against forged, replayed and malformed traffic.

<!-- nova-work:security:start -->

| feature | done |
|---|:---:|
| encrypted and signed packets (ChaCha20-Poly1305) | ✅ |
| encrypted connect token private data (XChaCha20-Poly1305) | ✅ |
| replay protection | ✅ |
| a used connect token is refused | ✅ |
| a full token history refuses rather than forgets | ✅ |
| a token created before the server started is refused | ✅ |
| no nonce reuse across a server restart | ✅ |
| malformed packets and tokens refused, fuzzed | ✅ |
| amplification protection | ❌ |
| each connection response is bound to its own challenge | ❌ |
| replay protection at the top of the sequence space | ❌ |
| pre-connect mappings expire even for tokens without a timeout | ❌ |
| servers sharing a connect token use distinct global packet nonces | ❌ |
| complete | 61% |

[Source data](docs/roadmap.sexp)

<!-- nova-work:security:end -->
